<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'expanded_entity_value'> ">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY base "Base Entity &ent;">
  <?target data-processing-instruction?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Top-level comment containing markup-like chars <>&"' -->
  <sub:child>
    <?sub:pi target="value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with entities &base; and tags <root></root> inside.
    ]]>
    &base;
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

  <!ELEMENT doc ANY>
  <!ENTITY % ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  %ext;
  <!ENTITY test "Test & Entity">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<doc xmlns:x="http://example.org/x" xmlns="http://example.org/default">
  <!-- Comment in default namespace -->
  <x:element>
    <?pi-target data="value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA block with xmlns:x attribute text.
    ]]>
    &test;
  </x:element>
</doc>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE note [
  <!ELEMENT note (to,from,body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY writer "John Doe">
  <!ENTITY copyright "Copyright © 2023">
  <!ENTITY % paramDTD "<!ENTITY dynamic 'dynamic_value'>">
  %paramDTD;
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
]>
<note xmlns="http://www.w3.org/TR/html4/" xmlns:author="http://example.com/author" xmlns:foo="http://example.com/foo">
  <!-- Author and copyright notice comment -->
  <author:to>&writer;</author:to>
  <from>©right;</from>
  <foo:body>
    <?foo-pi action="run"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA containing <foo:bar> and entity &dynamic; reference.
    ]]>
    &dynamic;
  </foo:body>
</note>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY pub "Global Publishing">
  <!ENTITY % entitySet "<!ENTITY internal 'Nested &pub;'>">
  %entitySet;
  <?catalog-control mode="strict"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns:lib="http://library.org" xmlns="http://default.org">
  <!-- Catalog comment block with entity &internal; hint -->
  <lib:book>
    <?lib:action type="refresh"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Book description CDATA with special symbols: <, >, &, ", '
    ]]>
    <title>&internal;</title>
    <author>Anonymous</author>
  </lib:book>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY header "Document Header">
  <!ENTITY content "Document Content &header;">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?doc-info author="Tester" version="1.0"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://xml.org/document" xmlns:sec="http://xml.org/section">
  <!-- Comprehensive test comment covering multiple subsystems -->
  <sec:section>
    <?sec:process command="compile"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- HTML/XML comment inside CDATA -->
      <sec:inner>CDATA block content with &content;</sec:inner>
    ]]>
    &content;
  </sec:section>
</document>
